title: Kourovka Notebook Problem 21.53
exact_target: For a conjugacy class of involutions in a finite simple group, do the first two prime product orders determine every colour-preserving symmetry?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 2562 (KOU-21.53). CC BY 4.0.

I. B. Gorshkov, Problem 21.53, in E. I. Khukhro and V. D. Mazurov (eds.), \emph{The Kourovka Notebook: Unsolved Problems in Group Theory}, 21st edition, arXiv:1401.0300v48 (6 October 2026). See also source definitions in Problems 21.52. This version records a negative answer; the displayed question is the historically registered target.
